defective_pattern: Triggering global directory-wide validation on 03_deliverables in decoupled pipelines when only JSON payloads are generated, before .md and .docx artifacts are synthesized.
why_defective: Causes validation cascade failures because uncertified or outdated draft artifacts contaminate validation suites, violating the Triad Invariant (Directive 3).
observed_symptoms: Validation cascade failures in decoupled pipelines
Validation checks running on incomplete Triad states
corrective_remedy: Delay global validation gates until all corresponding micro-stage .md and .docx deliverables are fully synthesized and synchronized to fulfill Directive 3.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect invocation of validation-agent or global validation tools on 03_deliverables when a decoupled pipeline has not completed Triad synchronization.
